The [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Gornt Seron]] maintained a '''castle''' in the [[Korbin Equatorial Range]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Korbin]]. The castle was located on a mountain ledge, which only two entrances; a docking facility on the side of the cliff accessible by [[Repulsorcraft/Legends|repulsorcraft]] or [[Starship/Legends|starship]], or a guard station on the ground. All access to the castle had to be approved by Seron or his [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]], [[Jontin]], and the castle was ringed by a [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]] network that ranged out to two [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]].
